description: Finds bounded active service-request inbox records for the authenticated business without exposing request descriptions, addresses, contact channels, or outreach controls. Use to search service requests in the connected business. Returns filters, service_requests, total, returned, resolution, scope.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to return.

q.description: Client name, service type, or request text.

view.description: Inbox view; defaults to active inbox records.

name: search-service-requests

filters.description: Filters metadata; empty collections retain their existing JSON array representation.

resolution.description: Resolution metadata; empty collections retain their existing JSON array representation.

scope.description: Authorization scope of this result; data remains restricted to the connected business.

service_requests.description: Bounded service requests records returned by this tool.

title: Service Request Search Tool
